sectionDescription: Configure custom Webhook to receive system events
fieldEnabledDesc: When enabled, the system will send HTTP requests to the configured URL
fieldMethodDesc: HTTP method used to send Webhook requests
fieldSecretDesc: Secret used to verify request origin, included in X-Webhook-Signature header
toastTestSuccess: Test request sent successfully. Please check your Webhook endpoint.
noteRetry: If endpoint returns non-2xx status, the system retries up to 3 times.
noteIdempotent: Implement idempotency on your endpoint to handle duplicate requests.
noteSecret: Strongly recommended to configure signing secret to verify request origin.
